_comment: Phase 01 criterion 4: `content.published.site` is pinned HERE and read from here, so the
receipt's host has exactly one source. Before this file the value had no configuration
surface at all -- `publish` builds a review pack and never touches `site`, and the Phase 00
steel thread passed the host by hand on the command line. A value typed at a prompt is a
value that is one typo away from a receipt claiming an article lives somewhere it does not,
and because `site` is in the idem preimage that receipt would be accepted as a distinct fact
rather than rejected as a mistake.
The address itself is ADR-1118 and is ONE-WAY. Changing this string is not a config tweak:
it is a domain move, and it costs every URL, every backlink and all Search Console history.
Anything editing it must also emit a supersede correction for every live receipt, which is
what `planCutover` in lib/cutover.mjs exists to produce.
A bare lowercase hostname. No scheme, no port, no path, no trailing dot -- the grammar in
validate-content.mjs is the authority and `loadSiteConfig` re-checks against it here, so a
bad value fails when the config is read rather than when a receipt is refused at the spine.
